video.agency.evidence: [地狱领主·codex] 代入地狱领主，我应追近并连续砍实目标。图1第3行第2–8格（4.25–5.75秒），我虽有转身、抬落剑动作，但未见能明确确认的背部横斩和肩背斜劈接触；第4行第1–4格（6.00–6.75秒）也无法确认格开来臂后顺势反砍胸口。拿不准这些动作是否真正击中，不能确认满足规格4.2–6.9秒连续有效追击的行为要求，判fail。；[树人·claude] Mostly coherent from my own (the treant's) point of view: 0.000–0.500 I charge in and swing an arm at the rider; 2.000–2.750 I swing again after being frosted; 3.000–5.750 I turn and run right with my legs moving the whole time; 6.000–6.500 I turn back and swing at him. Problems: 1) In 0.750–1.250 I stand in front of the horse's head with my arms spread and barely move. The spec wants me to swing as soon as I arrive (1–1.6s), but in these frames I mostly stand still, and you can't clearly see the swing and parry. 2) In 7.000–7.250 I stand upright and still in front of the horse, arms down, with no dodge, guard, or flinch. At 7.500 I suddenly become a dark-blue mass and collapse. I can't see a reaction to a vertical cleave hitting me (the spec has me look up at the falling sword at 6.9–7.8s). 3) For the slash across my back and the shoulder-back chop at 4.250–5.750, the frames are too small to tell whether I clearly stagger as the blade lands. The grid is low-res and some of this is uncertain, so I'm calling it fail.

video.readability.evidence: [audience·claude] Some things read clearly: a white-haired rider on a mount fights a tree monster. At 1.5–1.75s a small blue light at the tip of the rider's sword touches the monster. From 2.0–3.75s the monster turns pale blue-white, so it looks frozen. From 8.5–9.5s the monster breaks apart and falls. From 10–13.75s only a pile of remains is left on the ground while the rider stands still. What remains unclear: (1) The cause and effect breaks. After freezing at 2s, the monster keeps walking, waving its arms and attacking the rider from 4.0s to 7.25s. A first-time viewer can't tell whether the freeze did anything. (2) At 7.5s the monster suddenly turns dark blue, then collapses. I can't see the rider use a new skill or strike it in that cell or just before it, so I can't say what killed it. Was it the earlier freeze kicking in late, or a second attack? (3) The blue light at 1.5s is tiny and dim, so it barely reads as a skill. It doesn't match the 'more dazzling skill' bar. (4) The mount changes look partway through. From 0–3.75s it's a pale mount with a skeleton-like body. From 4–9.75s it's a shaggy dark beast. From 10s on it's a striped pale mount again. This makes the viewer wonder whether it's the same character. (5) The final remains (12–13.75s) are a green mossy pile, not ice or frozen debris. That doesn't match the freezing effect shown earlier. Overall, I can tell who cast what and who it hit. But I can't confidently explain how the result happened or when, so I'm marking this fail.
